evidence: Touches Guix build scripts under contrib/guix/ and adds GitHub Actions workflows for continuous Guix builds and codesigning verification.
rationale: Testing Guix release binaries continuously across native target environments in CI addresses a major blind spot where toolchain mismatches, broken Guix packaging, and missing codesigning dependencies currently go undetected until release time. Reviewers note that catching release-context issues prior to merge removes a significant recurring burden during release cycles.
